title: Shiraishi An — Don't Forget The Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, do you know how many people in our class are in the brass band?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The brass band?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, remember what we talked about?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shibuya Instrument Day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you two are gonna go help out?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, due to a slight emergency.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The manager of the shop who lends us the sound equipment we always use is gonna be there, but a few of his staff won't be able to make it, so he's shorthanded.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanted to learn a little more about trumpets before Shibuya Instrument Day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you wanna ask some people in the brass band about them?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I remember that Makita's in the band, but who else in our class is?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? I dunno... Probably no one else, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... Then, I'll start by asking Makita.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I vaguely remember seeing her play the trumpet during the school festival, so she should be able to help me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold on a second.
Have you actually talked to her before?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? With Makita?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Umm... We say hi sometimes, and we also talked a bit during the meetings for that film we made...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, you need to be careful not to scare her by getting all up in her face. Remember what happened with Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You wish to have lunch with Kusanagi, but things haven't been going as planned?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's like my timing's been really bad, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Well, I suppose life happens.
At the same time, you're in the same class this year, so I'm sure you'll get more opportunities to invite her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Assuming your aggressiveness hasn't scared her off already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? I haven't scared...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No! Nuh uh! I definitely haven't...!

rows.Speaker: Toya & Akito
rows.Line: (She hesitated...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah, that did happen...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Akito.
I'll try to be careful.
Lunch break

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Don't get up in her face, and try not to scare her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Um, Makita?
Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: Hi, Shiraishi. How can I help?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yes, she doesn't look scared! I'm off to a good start!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, I know this is really sudden, but I wanted to ask you a question.

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: Huh? Ask me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! This manager of a instrument shop I know is gonna be participating in Shibuya Instrument Day, and I'll be helping him with his booth.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't really know anything about musical instruments, so I was wondering if you could tell me a little about them.

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: Umm... I only joined the band in high school, so all I can really talk to you about is playing the trumpet...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
That's actually why I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, I may be able to help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, you're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, the shop I mentioned is on Vivid Street and I've known the manager for a really long time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He's always lending us his sound equipment, so I wanted to give back somehow!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Oh no...!
I'm talking like I always do now!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(After getting off to such a good start!
She seems a little overwhelmed now...)

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: Um, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...?

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line:
It's on Vivid Street?
Next to that general store?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line:
I knew it...!
That place has also been really good to me.

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: I go talk to the manager there whenever I'm having trouble playing something, because he loves trumpets and saxophones so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! You know him?!
Wait, does that also mean you know about Shibuya Instrument Day and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for giving me so much helpful info about trumpets, Makita!

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: No, if anything, I'm sorry for only being able to talk about really basic stuff. I'm still just a beginner myself.

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: I wish I could be there to help the manager since he's been so kind...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the convention is right before that big competition, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm guessing he didn't ask you to help because he already knew about that.

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: Oh... Come to think of it, I did promise him that I'd do my best...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, you gotta keep your promise!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In return, I'll work twice as hard to help the manager during the convention.

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we got so caught up in our conversation that we both forgot to eat. Did you bring a lunch today, Makita?

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line: No, I was thinking about buying something at the school store or cafeteria.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Then, let's go together!

rows.Speaker: Makita
rows.Line:
Okay!
The store's probably run out of stuff already, so how does the cafeteria sound?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Perfect! Hehe. I wonder what they're serving for lunch today.
